audit_items.proof_trace: The EMA-spot tolerance is correctly enforced on all safety-critical paths: both `debts_value_usd_non_liquidation` and `collaterals_usd_non_liquidation` (called by `is_obligation_safe` for borrow/withdraw) invoke `get_price_with_check`, which asserts `|ema - spot| / spot <= max_diff_allowed` and returns EMA (not spot), defeating flash-loan spot manipulation even within the tolerance band. Liquidation paths intentionally use plain `get_price` (EMA only) to avoid blocking liquidations during market volatility — an accepted design trade-off consistent with the inline comment at L1211-1212. The only residual risk is external Pyth oracle compromise, which is outside the contract's threat model.
